headline: Tarn Taran Stubble Fires Surge on October 18, 2025
briefing: On 2025-10-18, Tarn Taran recorded 25 fire detections with a total fire radiative power of 97.7 MW. This marks a 169.2 percent change versus the 7-day mean of 9.3 detections, placing it rank 1 in Punjab out of a total state count of 42. Satellite fire detections represent a lower bound due to missed fires, cloud cover, and overpass timing limitations [K090]. For the nearest monitored city of Amritsar, today's PM2.5 level was 70.1 ug/m3. The next-day PM2.5 forecast anticipates a p50 of 74.3 ug/m3, with an 80 percent uncertainty interval ranging from a p10 of 49.0 ug/m3 to a p90 of 84.6 ug/m3. Winds blew from the NW at 4.8 km/h, and upwind fire activity registered an upwind pressure score of 104.6. Fire detections are a lower bound and do not prove causation for PM2.5 levels.
